notes: Much faster right-click Extract here / Extract to <archive name>: a progress window appears instantly and extraction runs in the background (zip files unpack on several processor cores, with real byte-by-byte progress and original file dates)
Faster start: the app now installs as a folder instead of a self-unpacking file
New Search (Ctrl+F) with recent searches, search inside text files, and a Biggest files finder
New Power Tools window: duplicate finder, bulk rename, hidden-data scanner for pictures, checksums with Verify, split and join big files, password generator, empty-folder cleanup
New right-click tools: Properties with SHA-256, Copy path, Show in Explorer, Shred (secure delete), Remove photo data (GPS and camera), Compress to .tar.gz, New folder
Credits to Havenova X in Settings (click to visit havenovax.name.ng)
Announcements now have a "Don't show this again" option
Ad banner support (ads.json) shown under the toolbar, with a close button
Text editor, archive previews and instant archive opening from 1.3
